text: Three lessons of planning are done. This is the first lesson where Databricks actually opens, and the harborview catalog gets created for real.
Terraform creates the catalog and its bronze, silver, and gold schemas as declared, version-controlled infrastructure -- not a one-off command nobody can diff later.
The three Unity Catalog groups designed in the last lesson -- compliance_team, clinical_quality, billing_analysts -- get provisioned the same way.
Nothing with patient data in it exists yet on purpose. No claims tables, no row filter, no human group membership -- that's the foundation, not the furniture.
The container is real. Next: turning this plan into an actual running pipeline that lands claims data inside it.
